scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/sidepanel.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --target=chrome114 && cp manifest.json sidepanel.html sidepanel.css dist/
scripts.watch: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json sidepanel.html sidepanel.css dist/ && esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/sidepanel.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --target=chrome114 --watch
